tasks.label: Run requested command sequence
args:
import os,re,subprocess,datetime
cmds=[['python','-m','cricket_analyst.db','--demo'],['python','-m','cricket_analyst.rag','--ingest'],['pytest','tests/'],['python','-m','cricket_analyst.main','Build me a fantasy XI for CSK vs MI at Chepauk within 100 credits']]
r=re.compile(r'(?i)(api[_ -]?key|api[_ -]?secret|secret|token|password|passwd|authorization|bearer)(\s*[:=]\s*)[^\s,;]+')
def clean(s): return r.sub(lambda m:m.group(1)+m.group(2)+'[REDACTED]',s)
for a in cmds:
 p=subprocess.run(a,cwd=os.getcwd(),capture_output=True,text=True,errors='replace')
 print('=== COMMAND: '+' '.join(a)+' ===')
 print('EXIT CODE: '+str(p.returncode))
 print('--- STDOUT BEGIN ---'); print(clean(p.stdout),end='' if p.stdout.endswith('\\n') or not p.stdout else '\\n'); print('--- STDOUT END ---')
 print('--- STDERR BEGIN ---'); print(clean(p.stderr),end='' if p.stderr.endswith('\\n') or not p.stderr else '\\n'); print('--- STDERR END ---')
